question: The headquarters of the UNEP is located at_______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nairobi, Kenya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)**

 
 
• **UNEP** was established in **1972,**
 
• Since 1972 it is dealing with critical environmental challenges.
 
• **Its headquarters are located in Nairobi, Kenya.**
 
• UNEP is one of the leading global voices on the environment.
 
• The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the global authority.
 
• It sets the environmental agenda and promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system.
 
• It serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment.
 
• In March 2022, UNEP celebrated its 50th anniversary.
 
 
 
• **Reports published by UNEP**
 
 
• Emission Gap Report
 
• Adaptation Gap Report
 
• Global Environment Outlook
 
• Frontiers
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Environment Day**

 
 
• It is held annually on **5 June** since 1974
 
• It was led by the** United Nations Environment Programme** (UNEP) 
 
• World Environment Day is the largest global platform for environmental public outreach and is celebrated by millions of people across the world.
